30955-the-princess-idleways-a-fairy-stor.title: _A Fairy Story_
30955-the-princess-idleways-a-fairy-stor.creator: Mrs. W. J. Hays
30955-the-princess-idleways-a-fairy-stor.description: A book by Mrs. W. J. Hays. made a beautiful drapery. But the part of the castle in which Laura lived was no ruin. The thick walls kept it cool in summer and warm in winter, and made nice deep seats for the windows, which were hung with heavy folds of crimson silk. The walls were covered with superb paintings, the wide rooms were beautiful with all manner of comforts and luxuries.

arxiv-2012-02934.title: Superconductivity versus magnetism in the amorphous palladium “ides”: Pd 1-c (H/D/T) c Journal: Supercond. Sci. Technol.
arxiv-2012-02934.creator: I Rodríguez, R M Valladares, A Valladares, D Hinojosa-Romero, A A Valladares
arxiv-2012-02934.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by I Rodríguez, R M Valladares, A Valladares, D Hinojosa-Romero, A A Valladares. In general, conventional superconductivity and magnetism are competing phenomena. In some alloys this competition is a function of the concentration of the elements. Here we show that in the palladium alloys Pd 1-c (H/D/T) c (Pd-ides) the increase in the concentration c of the ides: hydrogen, deuterium, tritium (H/D/T), lowers the predicted magnetism of amorphous palladium ( a -Pd) gradually, allowing superconductivity to appear for c ≈ 40 % c\approx 40\% .

arxiv-2302-04257.title: Engineering Arbitrary Hamiltonians in Phase Space
arxiv-2302-04257.creator: Lingzhen Guo, Vittorio Peano
arxiv-2302-04257.description: Abstract We introduce a general method to engineer arbitrary Hamiltonians in the Floquet phase space of a periodically driven oscillator, based on the non-commutative Fourier transformation (NcFT) technique. We establish the relationship between an arbitrary target Floquet Hamiltonian in phase space and the periodic driving potential in real space.

arxiv-2312-03888.description: Abstract The detection of radio emission from an exoplanet would constitute the best way to determine its magnetic field. arxiv-2507-05363.title: Evaporating universes
arxiv-2507-05363.creator: Divij Gupta
arxiv-2507-05363.description: Abstract Recent work by Headrick, Sasieta and myself provides an extension of the HRT formula for asymptotically flat spacetimes. I use this formula to construct a holographic model of black hole evaporation in four-dimensional asymptotically flat spacetimes using Brill-Lindquist (BL) wormholes.

arxiv-2510-11267.title: Symplectic groups over Lie subgroups of involutive algebras
arxiv-2510-11267.creator: Eugen Rogozinnikov
arxiv-2510-11267.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Eugen Rogozinnikov. We introduce the symplectic group Sp 2 ⁡ ( G , σ ) \Sp_{2}(G,\sigma) associated to a Lie subgroup G G of a (possibly noncommutative) associative algebra A A equipped with an anti-involution σ \sigma . Our construction recovers several classical Lie groups as special cases, and in particular provides new realizations of spin groups as instances of Sp 2 ⁡ ( G , σ ) \Sp_{2}(G,\sigma) for suitable subgroups G G of the Clifford algebra.

pmc-11483414.description: BackgroundLymphoid enhancer-binding factor 1 (LEF1)/T cell factor (TCF) family members are key transcription factors in malignant tumors. pmc-11604996.title: Use of epigenetically modified bacteriophage and dual beta-lactams to treat a Mycobacterium abscessus sternal wound infection
pmc-11604996.creator: Madison Cristinziano, Elena Shashkina, Liang Chen, Jaime Xiao, Melissa B Miller, Christina Doligalski, Raymond Coakley, Leonard Jason Lobo, Brent Footer, Luther Bartelt, Lawrence Abad, Daniel A Russell, Rebecca Garlena, Michael J Lauer, Maggie Viland, Ari Kaganovsky, Emily Mowry, Deborah Jacobs-Sera
pmc-11604996.description: Nontuberculous mycobacterium (NTM) infections are challenging to manage and are frequently non-responsive to aggressive but poorly-tolerated antibiotic therapies. Immunosuppressed lung transplant patients are susceptible to NTM infections and poor patient outcomes are common. Bacteriophages present an alternative treatment option and are associated with favorable clinical outcomes. Similarly, dual beta-lactam combinations show promise in vitro, but clinical use is sparse.

pmc-12752735.title: Interplay between aging and metabolic diseases: from molecular mechanisms to therapeutic horizons
pmc-12752735.creator: Dandan Zhong, Yue Sun, Lanlan Zhao, Zhenchao Hu, Guanming Li, Hao Li, Zhengwei Xie
pmc-12752735.description: Aging and metabolic diseases are intricately linked through bidirectional molecular mechanisms that foster a harmful cycle of physiological decline. This cycle is driven by several key factors, including altered nutrient sensing, mitochondrial dysfunction, cellular senescence, chronic inflammation, epigenetic modifications, circadian rhythm disruptions, and imbalances in the gut microbiota. Emerging interventions targeting this aging-metabolism axis hold significant promise for extending healthspan.

pmc-12864638.title: The role of microRNAs on autophagy in cervical cancer: review
pmc-12864638.creator: Mulu Shiferw Asfaw, Woldeteklehaymanot Kassahun
pmc-12864638.description: Cervical cancer (CC) is one of the top five most common cancers among women worldwide. A key cellular alteration in CC is the dysregulation of autophagy a vital process for maintaining cell homeostasis by degrading and recycling damaged components via lysosomes. Disrupted autophagy is associated with various stages of cancer development.
